page.title: Legal Information
page.subtitle: Transparency and compliance are at the heart of our commitment. Find here all the legal and regulatory documents governing our money transfer services.
page.noResultsSub: Try modifying your search or selecting another category.

content.subtitle: Service Publisher
content.text: SendMe is an online money transfer service published by SendMe Technologies SA, registered with the Trade Register under number BE 0768.945.321.

content.subtitle: Registered Office
content.text:
SendMe Technologies SA
Avenue de la Toison d'Or 25
1050 Brussels, Belgium

content.subtitle: Regulatory Authority
content.text: SendMe is licensed as a payment institution by the National Bank of Belgium (NBB) under license number NBB-PAY-2024-0042. Our activities are supervised by the NBB and the Financial Services and Markets Authority (FSMA).

content.subtitle: Contact
content.text:
Email: legal@sendme.com
Phone: +32 (0)2 123 45 67
Customer service: support@sendme.com

content.subtitle: PSD2 Compliance
content.text: SendMe complies with Directive (EU) 2015/2366 on payment services in the internal market (PSD2). This directive strengthens the security of online payments and protects consumers against fraud.

content.subtitle: Strong Customer Authentication (SCA)
content.text: In accordance with PSD2, all transactions made via SendMe are subject to Strong Customer Authentication (SCA). This may include verification by SMS code, email or authentication application.

content.subtitle: Execution Times
content.text: Money transfers are executed within a maximum of 2 business days from receipt of funds, in accordance with PSD2 requirements. Transfers to certain mobile channels (Orange Money, MTN Mobile Money) may be instant.

content.subtitle: Data Controller
content.text: The data controller for your personal data is SendMe Technologies SA, located at Avenue de la Toison d'Or 25, 1050 Brussels, Belgium.

content.subtitle: Data Collected
content.text:
As part of our services, we collect the following data:

• Identity data: last name, first name, date of birth, nationality, address
• Contact data: email, phone number
• Financial data: IBAN, card information (via Stripe), transaction history
• Verification data: copy of ID, proof of address (KYC)
• Technical data: IP address, browser type, cookies

content.subtitle: Legal Basis for Processing
content.text:
The processing of your data is based on:

• Contract execution: to process your money transfers
• Legal obligations: to comply with AML/CFT regulations
• Your consent: for cookies and marketing communications
• Legitimate interest: to improve our services and prevent fraud

content.subtitle: Retention Period
content.text:
In accordance with Belgian and European regulations, your data is retained:

• Transaction data: 10 years (legal obligation)
• KYC data: 5 years after account closure
• Cookie data: 13 months maximum
• Marketing data: until consent withdrawal

content.subtitle: User Rights
content.text:
Under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR - Regulation EU 2016/679), you have the following rights:

• Right of access: obtain a copy of your personal data
• Right to rectification: correct inaccurate data
• Right to erasure: request deletion of your data (right to be forgotten)
• Right to restriction: limit the processing of your data
• Right to portability: receive your data in a structured format
• Right to object: object to processing for legitimate reasons

content.subtitle: Exercising Your Rights
content.text: To exercise your rights, contact our Data Protection Officer (DPO) at: dpo@sendme.com or by mail to our registered office. We undertake to respond to your request within a maximum of 30 days.

content.subtitle: Complaint to the Authority
content.text:
If you believe your rights are not being respected, you can lodge a complaint with the Belgian Data Protection Authority (DPA):

Data Protection Authority
Rue de la Presse 35, 1000 Brussels
Email: contact@apd-gba.be
Website: www.privacycommission.be

content.subtitle: What are cookies?
content.text: Cookies are small text files placed on your device (computer, smartphone, tablet) when you browse our site. They allow us to recognize your browser and improve your user experience.

content.subtitle: Essential Cookies
content.text:
These cookies are strictly necessary for the service to function. They allow us to:

• Authenticate you and maintain your session
• Secure your transactions
• Remember your language and theme preferences
• Enforce rate limits for security

content.subtitle: Analytical Cookies
content.text:
We use analytical cookies to understand how you use our service and improve it. These cookies collect anonymous data on:

• Pages visited and time spent
• Features used
• Any errors encountered

You can refuse these cookies at any time via our consent banner.

content.subtitle: Cookie Management
content.text: You can configure your cookie preferences at any time via our preference center accessible at the bottom of the page. You can also configure your browser to refuse or delete cookies. Please note that disabling essential cookies may affect the functioning of the service.

content.subtitle: Acceptance of Terms
content.text: By creating a SendMe account and using our services, you unreservedly accept these terms and conditions of use. If you do not accept these terms, please do not use our services.

content.subtitle: Eligibility
content.text:
To use SendMe, you must:

• Be at least 18 years old
• Have the legal capacity to contract
• Provide accurate and complete information
• Not be on an international sanctions list
• Reside in a country where SendMe is authorized to operate

content.subtitle: User Obligations
content.text:
As a user, you undertake to:

• Provide accurate and up-to-date identification information
• Not use the service for illegal or fraudulent purposes
• Not attempt to circumvent security measures
• Comply with applicable transaction limits
• Inform SendMe of any changes to your personal information

content.subtitle: Transaction Limits
content.text:
In accordance with Belgian and European regulations, the following limits apply:

• New account (level 1): up to €1,000 per transaction, €2,500 per month
• Verified account (level 2): up to €5,000 per transaction, €15,000 per month
• Premium account (level 3): personalized limits after enhanced verification

content.subtitle: Transfer Fees
content.text:
The fees applicable to each transfer are clearly indicated before the transaction is confirmed. They include:

• Service fee: variable percentage depending on the amount and destination
• Exchange fee: margin applied to the interbank exchange rate
• Channel fee: any fees related to the reception method (mobile money, bank transfer, etc.)

content.subtitle: Rate Transparency
content.text:
SendMe is committed to full transparency on exchange rates and fees. Before each transaction, you will see:

• The exact amount you are sending
• The exchange rate applied
• The total amount of fees
• The exact amount the beneficiary will receive

No hidden fees are applied.

content.subtitle: Right of Withdrawal
content.text: Under PSD2, you have a 14-day right of withdrawal for distance payment service contracts. However, this right does not apply once the transfer has been executed, in accordance with Article VI.53 of the Belgian Code of Economic Law.

content.subtitle: Data Encryption
content.text: All data transmitted through SendMe is protected by TLS 1.3 encryption (Transport Layer Security). Your payment information is processed via Stripe, which is PCI DSS Level 1 certified, the highest security level for financial transactions.

content.subtitle: Secure Storage
content.text: Your data is stored on secure servers located in the European Union, in compliance with GDPR. We use technical and organizational security measures to protect your data against unauthorized access, loss or disclosure.

content.subtitle: Data Sharing
content.text:
SendMe only shares your personal data with:

• Our payment partners (Stripe, banking partners) for transaction processing
• Regulatory authorities (NBB, FSMA, DPA) when required by law
• Our KYC providers for identity verification

We never sell your personal data to third parties.

content.subtitle: Our Commitment
content.text: SendMe is subject to the Belgian law of September 18, 2017 on the prevention of money laundering and terrorist financing, transposing European directives 2015/849 and 2018/843.

content.subtitle: KYC Procedure (Know Your Customer)
content.text:
To comply with our legal obligations, we carry out an identity verification of our users. This procedure may include:

• Identity document verification (passport, ID card)
• Proof of address less than 3 months old
• Selfie or video verification
• Questionnaire on the origin of funds (for high amounts)

content.subtitle: Reporting Suspicious Transactions
content.text: In accordance with the law, SendMe is required to report any suspicious transaction to the Belgian Financial Intelligence Processing Unit (CTIF). This legal obligation takes precedence over professional secrecy and confidentiality.

content.subtitle: International Sanctions
content.text:
SendMe systematically checks all users and transactions against sanctions lists published by:

• The European Union (EU)
• The United Nations (UN)
• The Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC)
• The Belgian Treasury

content.subtitle: How to file a complaint?
content.text:
If you are not satisfied with our services, you can file a complaint:

• By email to: complaints@sendme.com
• By mail to: SendMe Technologies SA, Complaints Department, Avenue de la Toison d'Or 25, 1050 Brussels
• Via our contact form in your customer area

content.subtitle: Processing Times
content.text: We will acknowledge receipt of your complaint within 5 business days and undertake to provide you with a reasoned response within a maximum of 15 business days. For complex cases, this period may be extended to 30 business days, with prior notice.

content.subtitle: Mediation
content.text:
If you are not satisfied with our response, you may refer the matter to the Financial Services Mediator (Ombudsfin):

Ombudsfin
Place de la Station 1
1080 Brussels
Website: www.ombudsfin.be
Email: reclamations@ombudsfin.be
